title: Director, Protein Operations
text:
Twist Bioscience is seeking a Director, Protein Operations to lead high-throughput protein production and characterization within our Operations organization. You will run a high-throughput operation that runs seven days a week and lead a large, multi-level team that delivers purified, well-characterized antibodies and proteins to internal programs and external customers on time, at quality, and at cost. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in protein expression, purification, and characterization with the rigor to scale a production organization and the drive to automate it.

**Leadership and Operations**

* Lead a large protein production and characterization organization that operates seven days a week, including managers, supervisors, scientists, and associates.
* Own key performance indicators (KPIs) for quality, on-time delivery, turnaround time (TAT), capacity, and cost of goods sold (COGS), and model capacity and staffing against demand.
* Drive continuous process improvement and lead complex investigations, including customer incidents.
* Maintain SOPs, documentation, and training in line with ISO 13485 and other regulatory requirements.

**Protein Production**

* Oversee high-throughput antibody production in HEK293, CHO, and cell-free systems across IgG, Fab, scFv, VHH, and bispecific formats.
* Lead downstream purification of diverse biologics, including bispecific and engineered antibodies.
* Transfer new products and processes from R&D into production and support new product introductions (NPI).

**Protein and Antibody Characterization**

* Oversee Twist's binding, developability, and cell-based functional assay suite, from assay development through execution, analysis, and data reporting, with turnaround times as fast as 1–5 business days.
* Lead binding assessment, including flow cytometry on native antigen, single-point and full kinetics/affinity (KD) by SPR and BLI, and epitope binning by SPR and BLI.
* Lead developability profiling, including analytical size-exclusion chromatography (aSEC), thermostability (nanoDSF), size distribution (DLS), polyspecificity (BVP ELISA, ovalbumin off-target), self-interaction (AC-SINS), and hydrophobic interaction screening.
* Deliver high-quality, consistent datasets that support customer lead selection and AI/ML model training.

**Automation and Scale**

* Partner with Engineering to bring a high level of automation to production and characterization, translating workflows into requirements for liquid handling, robotics, scheduling, and data systems.
* Drive walk-away, high-throughput workflows integrated with LIMS, MES, and SAP to increase capacity, reduce turnaround time, and improve reproducibility.

**Collaboration**

* Partner with R&D, Process Development, Supply Chain, QC, QA, Project Management, and Customer Support to grow the portfolio and meet customer commitments.
* Shape technology and product direction with senior leadership while staying current on antibody discovery, protein expression, and lab automation.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* PhD in protein biochemistry, biological chemistry, immunology, or a related field with 8+ years of experience in biotech, biopharma, or life science tools; or a BS/MS with 12+ years of equivalent experience.
* Experience managing managers and leading large teams, with strong coaching and people development skills.
* A proven track record of scaling protein or antibody production workflows and commercial products.
* Hands-on expertise in mammalian expression, purification (e.g., ÄKTA), and antibody characterization, including SPR/BLI kinetics and epitope binning, flow cytometry, and developability assays (aSEC, nanoDSF, DLS, AC-SINS, polyspecificity).
* Success partnering with engineering teams to implement automated, high-throughput lab workflows.
* Experience owning budgets, KPIs, and capacity planning, with working knowledge of ISO 13485/GMP, Lean, and Six Sigma.
* A strategic thinker who executes tactically, prioritizes well, and influences senior leadership.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience running a high-throughput, made-to-order production operation in the life sciences.
* Experience manufacturing and purifying engineered antibodies.
* Experience with antibody characterization platforms such as Carterra and Octet.
* Familiarity with LIMS, MES, and ERP/SAP systems.

**About Twist Bioscience**

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as "writing" DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care,agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers.
